mapper.select: SELECT p.PROJ_ID AS "projectId", p.PROJ_NM AS "projectName", p.CTRT_TYPE_CD AS "contractTypeCode", COALESCE(c.CODE_NM,p.CTRT_TYPE_CD) AS "contractTypeName", p.PROJ_STAT_CD AS "statusCode", p.CTRT_BGN_DT AS "startDate", p.CTRT_END_DT AS "endDate", p.ORGNL_CTRT_AMT AS "originalAmount", p.CTRT_AMT AS "contractAmount", p.BDGT_AMT AS "budget", p.TEAM_EXPS_AMT AS "team", p.PROJ_EXPS_AMT AS "expense", n.mm AS "plannedMm", (p.MOD_DTTM AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul')::date AS "modifiedDate" FROM TB_PJ_PROJ p LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE c ON c.CODE_GRP_ID='CTRT_TYPE' AND c.CODE=p.CTRT_TYPE_CD LEFT JOIN (SELECT m.PROJ_ID, sum(m.PLAN_MM) AS mm FROM TB_PJ_MNPW_PLAN m GROUP BY m.PROJ_ID) n ON n.PROJ_ID=p.PROJ_ID WHERE TRUE ORDER BY p.PROJ_ID

SELECT h.PROJ_ID AS "projectId", h.CHG_ITEM_CD AS "itemCode", h.CHG_ITEM_NM AS "itemName", h.BFR_VAL AS "beforeValue", h.AFT_VAL AS "afterValue", h.CHG_DT AS "changeDate" FROM TB_PJ_PROJ_CHG h ORDER BY h.CHG_DT,h.HIST_SN

SELECT c.COST_YM AS "yearMonth", c.DEV_ID AS "developerId", c.PROJ_ID AS "projectId", c.ASGN_ID AS "assignmentId", c.ASGN_MM AS "mm", c.FREE_MM AS "freeMm", c.SALES_AMT AS "revenue", c.LABOR_ALLOC_AMT AS "labor", c.TEAM_EXPS_AMT AS "team", c.PROJ_EXPS_AMT AS "expense", c.CTRT_TYPE_CD AS "contractTypeCode" FROM TB_CO_MON_COST c WHERE c.COST_YM <= ORDER BY c.COST_YM,c.DEV_ID,c.PROJ_ID,c.ASGN_ID

WITH periods AS ( SELECT a.ASGN_ID,a.DEV_ID,a.PROJ_ID,a.JOB_CD,a.INPUT_TYPE_CD,a.CTRT_MM,a.BILL_UPRC, greatest(a.INPUT_BGN_DT,p.CTRT_BGN_DT) AS first_day, least(a.INPUT_END_DT,p.CTRT_END_DT) AS last_day FROM TB_PJ_ASGN a JOIN TB_PJ_PROJ p ON p.PROJ_ID=a.PROJ_ID WHERE a.ASGN_STAT_CD != 'CNCL' ), months AS ( SELECT a.*, m::date AS month_start, (m+interval '1 month'-interval '1 day')::date AS month_end,to_char(m,'YYYYMM') AS ym FROM periods a CROSS JOIN LATERAL generate_series(date_trunc('month',a.first_day), date_trunc('month',a.last_day),interval '1 month') m ), effective AS ( SELECT a.*,COALESCE(h.mm,a.CTRT_MM) AS contract_mm,COALESCE(h.price,a.BILL_UPRC) AS price FROM months a LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN trim(x.BFR_VAL) ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN trim(x.BFR_VAL)::numeric END FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_HIST x WHERE x.ASGN_ID=a.ASGN_ID AND x.APLY_DT > a.month_end AND x.NEW_CTRT_MM IS NOT NULL ORDER BY x.APLY_DT,x.HIST_SN LIMIT 1), (SELECT x.NEW_CTRT_MM FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_HIST x WHERE x.ASGN_ID=a.ASGN_ID AND x.APLY_DT <= a.month_end AND x.NEW_CTRT_MM IS NOT NULL ORDER BY x.APLY_DT DESC,x.HIST_SN DESC LIMIT 1)) AS mm, COALESCE((SELECT CASE WHEN trim(x.BFR_VAL) ~ '^[0-9]+([.][0-9]+)?$' THEN trim(x.BFR_VAL)::numeric END FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_HIST x WHERE x.ASGN_ID=a.ASGN_ID AND x.APLY_DT > a.month_end AND x.NEW_UPRC IS NOT NULL ORDER BY x.APLY_DT,x.HIST_SN LIMIT 1), (SELECT x.NEW_UPRC FROM TB_PJ_ASGN_HIST x WHERE x.ASGN_ID=a.ASGN_ID AND x.APLY_DT <= a.month_end AND x.NEW_UPRC IS NOT NULL ORDER BY x.APLY_DT DESC,x.HIST_SN DESC LIMIT 1)) AS price ) h ON true ), amounts AS ( SELECT a.*, CASE WHEN a.ym <= THEN COALESCE(n.MON_MM,round(a.contract_mm* (least(a.last_day,a.month_end)-greatest(a.first_day,a.month_start)+1)/extract(day from a.month_end),2)) ELSE round(a.contract_mm*(least(a.last_day,a.month_end)-greatest(a.first_day,a.month_start)+1) /extract(day from a.month_end),2) END AS mm, n.SALES_AMT AS stored_sales FROM effective a LEFT JOIN TB_PJ_ASGN_MON n ON n.ASGN_ID=a.ASGN_ID AND n.INPUT_YM=a.ym ) SELECT a.ym AS "yearMonth",a.DEV_ID AS "developerId",a.PROJ_ID AS "projectId", a.ASGN_ID AS "assignmentId",COALESCE(j.CODE_NM,a.JOB_CD) AS "jobName", a.INPUT_TYPE_CD AS "inputTypeCode",a.mm AS "mm", CASE WHEN a.INPUT_TYPE_CD='FREE' THEN 0 ELSE COALESCE(a.stored_sales,trunc(a.price*a.mm),0) END AS "revenue", a.price AS "unitPrice" FROM amounts a LEFT JOIN TB_SY_CODE j ON j.CODE_GRP_ID='JOB' AND j.CODE=a.JOB_CD ORDER BY a.ym,a.DEV_ID,a.PROJ_ID,a.ASGN_ID
SELECT e.PROJ_ID AS "projectId",e.EXPS_YM AS "yearMonth",sum(e.EXPS_AMT) AS "amount" FROM TB_PJ_DRCT_EXPS e WHERE e.EXPS_YM <= GROUP BY e.PROJ_ID,e.EXPS_YM ORDER BY e.PROJ_ID,e.EXPS_YM
SELECT p.DEV_ID AS "developerId",p.APLY_BGN_YM AS "startMonth",p.APLY_END_YM AS "endMonth", p.MON_PAY_AMT AS "amount" FROM TB_HR_DEV_PRC p ORDER BY p.DEV_ID,p.APLY_BGN_YM

SELECT t.PROJ_ID AS "projectId",t.DSTRB_YM AS "yearMonth",sum(t.DSTRB_AMT) AS "amount" FROM TB_PJ_TK_DSTRB t WHERE t.DSTRB_YM <= AND t.ROW_TYPE_CD='DEV' AND t.DSTRB_STEP_CD=(SELECT z.DSTRB_STEP_CD FROM TB_PJ_TK_DSTRB z JOIN TB_SY_CODE c ON c.CODE_GRP_ID='DSTRB_STEP' AND c.CODE=z.DSTRB_STEP_CD WHERE z.PROJ_ID=t.PROJ_ID ORDER BY CASE c.CODE_NM WHEN '실제 투입계획' THEN 3 WHEN '최종 계약' THEN 2 WHEN '견적' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, z.DSTRB_STEP_CD LIMIT 1) GROUP BY t.PROJ_ID,t.DSTRB_YM ORDER BY t.PROJ_ID,t.DSTRB_YM

SELECT t.PROJ_ID AS "projectId",t.DEV_ID AS "developerId",t.DSTRB_YM AS "yearMonth",sum(t.DSTRB_AMT) AS "amount" FROM TB_PJ_TK_DSTRB t WHERE t.ROW_TYPE_CD='DEV' AND t.DEV_ID IS NOT NULL AND t.DSTRB_STEP_CD=(SELECT z.DSTRB_STEP_CD FROM TB_PJ_TK_DSTRB z JOIN TB_SY_CODE c ON c.CODE_GRP_ID='DSTRB_STEP' AND c.CODE=z.DSTRB_STEP_CD WHERE z.PROJ_ID=t.PROJ_ID ORDER BY CASE c.CODE_NM WHEN '실제 투입계획' THEN 3 WHEN '최종 계약' THEN 2 WHEN '견적' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END DESC, z.DSTRB_STEP_CD LIMIT 1) GROUP BY t.PROJ_ID,t.DEV_ID,t.DSTRB_YM ORDER BY t.PROJ_ID,t.DEV_ID,t.DSTRB_YM

SELECT DISTINCT ON (w.PROJ_ID) w.PROJ_ID AS "projectId",w.ACTL_PRGRS_RT AS "actualProgress" FROM TB_PJ_WEEK_MEMO w WHERE w.WRT_DT < make_date(#{year},#{baseMonth},1)+interval '1 month' AND w.ACTL_PRGRS_RT IS NOT NULL ORDER BY w.PROJ_ID,w.WRT_DT DESC,w.MEMO_SN DESC

SELECT h.DEV_ID AS "developerId",h.DEV_NM AS "developerName",h.BLNG_CLNT_ID AS "affiliationId", '' AS "affiliationName",h.JBPS_CD AS "positionCode",'' AS "positionName",h.EMP_TYPE_CD AS "employeeTypeCode", '' AS "employeeTypeName",h.JNCMP_DT AS "joinDate",h.RETIRE_DT AS "retireDate", h.JOB_CD AS "jobCode",'' AS "jobName",h.GRADE_CD AS "gradeCode",'' AS "gradeName", h.PART_ID AS "salesPartId",h.DRCT_CLS_CD AS "directClassCode",h.MNG_NO AS "managementNumber", '' AS "salesPartName" FROM TB_HR_DEV h ORDER BY h.DEV_ID

SELECT p.PAY_YM AS "yearMonth",p.DEV_ID AS "developerId",p.EMP_TYPE_CD AS "employeeTypeCode", p.PAY_AMT AS "salary",p.ALWNC_AMT AS "allowance",p.INSR_CMPNY_AMT AS "companyInsurance", p.RETIRE_RSV_AMT AS "retirementReserve",p.INSR_SELF_AMT AS "personalInsurance", p.WTHLD_TAX_AMT AS "withholdingTax",p.INCM_TAX_AMT AS "incomeTax",p.REAL_PAY_AMT AS "netPay", p.VNDR_SPLY_AMT AS "vendorSupply" FROM TB_HR_MON_PAY p WHERE p.PAY_YM <= ORDER BY p.PAY_YM,p.DEV_ID

SELECT s.DEV_ID AS "developerId",s.BGN_DT AS "startDate",s.END_DT AS "endDate" FROM TB_HR_DEV_STAT s WHERE s.WORK_STAT_CD='LEAVE' AND s.BGN_DT < make_date(#{year},#{baseMonth},1)+interval '1 month' ORDER BY s.DEV_ID,s.BGN_DT

SELECT c.CODE_GRP_ID AS "groupCode",c.CODE AS "code",c.CODE_NM AS "name",c.CODE_VAL AS "value" FROM TB_SY_CODE c WHERE c.USE_YN='Y' AND c.DEL_YN='N' ORDER BY c.CODE_GRP_ID,c.SORT_ORD NULLS LAST,c.CODE
